name: Top-k Critical Paths in DAGs
problem_statement: Return up to k distinct source-to-sink paths of greatest total edge delay in a directed acyclic graph.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

required_outputs.name: paths
required_outputs.description: Edge sequences and total weights in nonincreasing cost order.

required_outputs.name: complete
required_outputs.description: True if the top-k request or exhaustion of all paths is certified.

solution_semantics.objective: Rank distinct DAG paths by descending total delay.
solution_semantics.exactness: Exact top-k ranking; equal-cost ties may be selected arbitrarily at the kth boundary.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Every path follows edges from an allowed source to an allowed sink.
Recompute costs and compare to exhaustive small-DAG enumeration.
edge_cases: Return fewer than k paths if fewer exist.
Parallel edges define distinct edge-sequence paths.

correctness: Every path follows edges from an allowed source to an allowed sink.
Recompute costs and compare to exhaustive small-DAG enumeration.
